breaking.fix: Write file.look({extends:['low-poly']}) instead of faceted-low-poly or toy-3d, ['cartoon'] instead of cartoon-2d or inked-comic-3d, ['anime'] instead of anime-cel-3d, and ['neon'] instead of neon-vector. Keep ['pixel'], but remove variant:'topdown' and choose creation view:'top-down-2d'. Remove variant:'paper'; there is no paper replacement. For Realistic omit look entirely; none is only the creation picker's sentinel. Read the new categories and view coverage from looks/catalogue.json and regenerate creation.json from this engine release.
